boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with currently published late availability on campus or in Terre Haute.

cards.title: Logan's at Logan Library
cards.subtitle: Rose-Hulman campus
cards.notes: Use the library coffee shop for a late sandwich, salad, dessert, or drink. Check the academic-calendar schedule before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A campus food option operating until midnight on regular Sunday through Thursday evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose-Hulman's campus map lists Logan's hours as 6 p.m.–midnight Sunday and 3 p.m.–midnight Monday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published regular hours: Sunday 6 p.m.–midnight; Monday–Thursday 3 p.m.–midnight; closed Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Subway in Mees Hall
cards.subtitle: Rose-Hulman campus
cards.notes: Order carryout or eat in at the campus Subway when it is open; verify the day because the posted schedule excludes Saturdays.
cards.short_summary: A campus Subway with regular service through midnight on most weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose-Hulman's campus map lists the Subway in Mees Hall and posts midnight closing Sunday through Friday.
cards.access_notes: Published regular hours: Sunday 4 p.m.–midnight; Monday–Friday 10:30 a.m.–midnight; closed Saturday.

cards.title: IHOP on South 3rd Street
cards.subtitle: 2901 S 3rd St, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery from this all-hours location. Confirm transportation and any service-specific availability before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Terre Haute IHOP for food at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official Terre Haute late-night page lists this 2901 S 3rd St restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Denny's on U.S. Highway 41
cards.subtitle: 3442 US Highway 41, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Check the day-specific restaurant schedule before heading out; this location publishes late service and offers dine-in, takeout, and walk-ins.
cards.short_summary: A diner with late or 24-hour service depending on the day.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page lists service until 1 a.m. on several weekdays and 24-hour hours Friday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 6 a.m.–1 a.m. on Monday–Wednesday and 24 hours Friday–Sunday; Thursday closes at midnight.

cards.title: McDonald's on State Road 46
cards.subtitle: 2633 State Rd 46, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest option at this location, or arrive before midnight for the published restaurant and lobby schedule.
cards.short_summary: A State Road 46 stop with a 24-hour drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official location page lists 24-hour drive-thru service and restaurant/lobby hours ending at midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours as 24 hours daily; restaurant and lobby hours are 5 a.m.–midnight daily.

cards.title: Chava's on Wabash
cards.subtitle: 669 Wabash Ave, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Check the posted day before going downtown, then use the counter-service restaurant for a late meal without relying on a bar setting.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Mexican restaurant with posted service as late as 4 a.m. on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Chava's official site lists Terre Haute hours through 2 a.m. Monday, 3 a.m. Tuesday–Wednesday, and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Sunday to midnight, Monday to 2 a.m., Tuesday–Wednesday to 3 a.m., and Thursday–Saturday to 4 a.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Wabash Avenue
cards.subtitle: 3132 Wabash Ave, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the widest late window at this Wabash Avenue location; the dining room has an earlier published closing time.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru listed as 24 hours Friday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists 24-hour drive-thru service Friday through Sunday and late weekday drive-thru hours.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: to 4 a.m. Monday–Wednesday, 5:30 a.m. Thursday, and open 24 hours Friday–Sunday. Dining room is listed to midnight.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South U.S. 41
cards.subtitle: 3636 S US Highway 41, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Plan on the drive-thru after the dining room closes, and check the restaurant page again on the day in case location hours change.
cards.short_summary: A South U.S. 41 Taco Bell with drive-thru service listed nearly around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists daily drive-thru hours from 5:30 a.m. to 5:29 a.m. the next day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours of 5:30 a.m.–5:29 a.m. daily; dining-room hours are listed separately and end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South State Road 46
cards.subtitle: 2319 S State Road 46, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Use this State Road 46 location for a late drive-thru order, or arrive by midnight if you need the published dine-in window.
cards.short_summary: A daily 3 a.m. drive-thru option on State Road 46.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists this restaurant's drive-thru as open until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours from 9 a.m. to 3 a.m. daily; published dine-in hours end at midnight.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Lafayette Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2105 Lafayette Ave, Terre Haute
cards.notes: Check the day-specific drive-thru window before leaving; Friday and Saturday have the latest posted closing time at this location.
cards.short_summary: A Lafayette Avenue drive-thru listed through 4 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists drive-thru hours until 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday and until 3 a.m. on other days.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours: to 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and to 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dining room is listed to midnight.
